channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: O'Sullivan returns to Dr Crokes hotseat
item.description: Kerry giants Dr Crokes have appointed Edmund O'Sullivan as their new senior football manager.

item.title: Galway footballers won't grace Tuam Stadium again this year
item.description: Many Galway football fans are lamenting the prospect of not seeing the county's senior footballers in action at Tuam Stadium again this year.

item.title: Dublin players to protest over Allianz League sponsorship
item.description: Dublin's senior footballers and hurlers are planning to protest over Allianz's continued sponsorship of the National Leagues this weekend.

item.title: Demolition of Casement Park to start next week
item.description: Ulster GAA have confirmed that the old stand in Casement Park will be demolished with work commencing the last week in January.

item.title: First Minister welcomes progress on Casement Park
item.description: The North's First Minister Michelle O'Neill has welcomed the commencement of works to 'prepare for the regeneration' of Casement Park.

item.title: Big names omitted from Cork hurling panel
item.description: New Cork hurling boss Ben O'Connor has announced a 36-man panel ahead of Sunday's Allianz Hurling league opening defence against Waterford at SuperValu Páirc Uí Chaoimh.

item.title: TG4 announces extensive Allianz League coverage
item.description: TG4 will broadcast over 45 games during this year's Allianz Football and Hurling Leagues, up to and including all divisional finals.

item.title: Thirteen new additions to Tipp hurling panel
item.description: Tipperary hurling manager Liam Cahill has named a 43-man panel - which includes 13 players who weren't involved last year - for the upcoming Allianz League campaign.

item.title: Rochford recommits to Tullamore
item.description: Stephen Rochford will be involved with the Tullamore senior footballers again this year.

item.title: Geaney confirmed as Kerry football captain
item.description: Fresh from leading Dingle to All-Ireland club SFC glory last Sunday, Paul Geaney has been named as the new Kerry captain for the 2026.
